# Summary
Provide a summary of what you want to investigate. E.g. "Zephyr has built-in radio stacks for various protocols, e.g. LoRaWAN and BLE. Investigate how these radios should be managed and used in the platform."

## Details
Describe what you want to get out of the investigation. E.g. if you are investigating a radio module, someone should be able to pick up your results and begin the implementation.

## Deliverables
Since investigations normally don't result in a change to the code-base, describe what should be completed to finish the investigation (e.g. flow charts, pseudo-code, documentation etc..)
